beforePause.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
SWIPE INSTRUCTIONS ↑
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.
MOVE with the left thumb. Swipe the scene to turn quickly. Tap a visible enemy or coil to center your aim, then hold FIRE. FIRE drags make fine corrections; AIM slows them further. Tap TURN on a warning to face offscreen danger.
Hold the left ROUTE control to travel; keep it held while firing or using AIM to defend. Scene touch gives free look. MOVE, DASH or JUMP takes over. Near a receiver, keep holding to recover; release after SAVED. MAP pauses for planning.
After three memories, destroy the numbered copper coils. Amber means cover; cyan means an exposed firing window. Move to a clear face.
When the jammer falls, return to the marked uplink deck and survive the upload. DASH helps reposition; JUMP becomes VAULT near low cover.
FULL TACTICAL HANDBOOK
UNDERSTOOD
↗
